definitions.explanation: Causing no harm, injury, or damage. Used for substances, animals, actions, or people that pose no danger.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無害|むがい}です。
{人体|じんたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無害|むがい}な⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: It is made from ingredients that are harmless to the human body.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{化学物質|かがくぶっしつ}→化学物質：19856_kagakubusshitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無害|むがい}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It has been confirmed through experiments that this chemical substance is harmless to the environment.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without; non-) and ⟦{害|がい}→害：02542_gai⟧ (harm; damage). Functions as a na-adjective with な (e.g., {無害|むがい}な) and as a noun. Commonly used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to specify what something is harmless to.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人体|じんたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無害|むがい}: harmless to the human body
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無害|むがい}: environmentally harmless
- {無害|むがい}な⟦{物質|ぶっしつ}→物質：03608_busshitsu⟧: a harmless substance
- {無害|むがい}な⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧: a harmless organism
- {無害|むがい}{化|か}: rendering harmless; detoxification

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧: harmful; toxic — the direct antonym
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧: safe — broader term covering freedom from all danger, not just absence of harm
- ⟦{無毒|むどく}→無毒：27157_mudoku⟧: nontoxic; nonvenomous — specifically about absence of poison or venom
